candidates.title: Prepare due-date reminders from a sheet

demandEvidence.chore: connect Google Sheets to my Make scenario using the Search Rows module so I can automate reminders based on due dates stored in a spreadsheet.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I want to connect Google Sheets to my Make scenario using the Search Rows module so I can automate reminders based on due dates stored in a spreadsheet.

ease.reason: A fictional-input mock is approachable, but no supplied reference documents Sheets or Make integration.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: service operators may pay for reminder setup; this request proves no AI-service buyer or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can prepare reminders from sample due dates; live access and delivery constraints are unknown.

autonomy.reason: A configured task could repeat reminder preparation, but a person must check dates and approve messages.

evidence.reason: The post names Search Rows and due-date reminders, but gives no frequency, constraints or implementation evidence.

candidates.reason: Below threshold (mean 4.6). A narrow experiment could prepare reminders from operator-supplied sample dates, but no implementation reference supports the integration and a human must verify dates and approve messages.
